name: etl-clang
summary: ETL template-conformance battery (clang-built C++ — ETLCPP/etl 20.48.1 unit tests, T2 of the C++ port ladder)

etl-tests.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Menu launcher: etl-clang is a tty app (the ETL conformance battery on
# stdout), so run it in a terminal window and hold the window open for the
# verdict. Self-location is a known-prefix probe (todos/0444): /opt/<name>
# installed, /usr/opt/<name> baked; `[` is a hush builtin — zero spawns
# (the old dirname-of-realpath command substitution cost four processes).
# Variable-free by design (#296): builtins and literal paths only.
[ -d /opt/etl-clang ] && exec term sh -c "/opt/etl-clang/etl-clang; echo; echo '[etl battery done — press Enter to close]'; read _"
exec term sh -c "/usr/opt/etl-clang/etl-clang; echo; echo '[etl battery done — press Enter to close]'; read _"
